description: Patch schema for local Z-Image text-to-image generation through ComfyUI-GGUF plus ComfyUI core nodes.

unmapped_ui_parameters.image: Image input is handled by the companion zimage_t2i_i2i_img2img workflow when ModelInputs.mode is img2img.
unmapped_ui_parameters.strength: Image strength is mapped to KSampler denoise only in the companion img2img workflow.
unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The image-plugin frame control is preserved by the surrounding UI but this workflow emits one PNG per generate call.

output.contract: Return one readable PNG image matching the mapped requested dimensions.
